question: For email lists subscribed by either support staff or faculty, list its name, the number of subscribers that are support staff, the number of subscribers that are faculty, as well as its active status.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "mailing_lists" AS SELECT "moira_list_key" AS "moira_list_key", "moira_list_name" AS "moira_list_name", "is_active" AS "is_active", "is_moira_mailing_list" AS "is_moira_mailing_list" FROM beaver."moira_list";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "mailing_list_members" AS SELECT "moira_list_key" AS "moira_list_key", "moira_list_member_mit_id" AS "moira_list_member_mit_id" FROM beaver."moira_list_detail";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "faculty_roster" AS SELECT "mit_id" AS "mit_id" FROM beaver."hr_faculty_roster";
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "employee_directory" AS SELECT "mit_id" AS "mit_id", "type" AS "employee_group", "type" AS "employee_type", "title" AS "title", "appointment_type" AS "appointment_type", "type" AS "type" FROM beaver."warehouse_users";

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE faculty_ids AS
SELECT DISTINCT CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id
FROM faculty_roster
WHERE mit_id IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM faculty_ids;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE employee_ids AS
SELECT DISTINCT CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id,
       UPPER(COALESCE(employee_group,'')) AS employee_group,
       UPPER(COALESCE(employee_type,'')) AS employee_type,
       UPPER(COALESCE(type,'')) AS type_flag
FROM employee_directory
WHERE mit_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE support_ids AS
SELECT e.mit_id
FROM employee_ids e
LEFT JOIN faculty_ids f ON f.mit_id = e.mit_id
WHERE f.mit_id IS NULL
  AND (
        type_flag = 'EMPLOYEE'
        OR employee_type IN ('SUPPORT STAFF','SUPPORT','STAFF')
        OR employee_group IN ('NONEXEMPT','EXEMPT')
        OR (employee_type = '' AND employee_group <> '' AND type_flag <> 'STUDENT')
      );
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_ids;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE list_members_clean AS
SELECT m.moira_list_key,
       CAST(m.moira_list_member_mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id
FROM mailing_list_members m
WHERE m.moira_list_member_mit_id IS NOT NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM list_members_clean;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH per_member AS (
  SELECT lm.moira_list_key,
         CASE WHEN f.mit_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_faculty,
         CASE WHEN s.mit_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_support
  FROM list_members_clean lm
  LEFT JOIN faculty_ids f ON f.mit_id = lm.mit_id
  LEFT JOIN support_ids s ON s.mit_id = lm.mit_id
), per_list AS (
  SELECT moira_list_key,
         SUM(is_support) AS support_staff_subscribers,
         SUM(is_faculty) AS faculty_subscribers
  FROM per_member
  GROUP BY moira_list_key
)
SELECT l.moira_list_name AS list_name,
       COALESCE(p.support_staff_subscribers,0) AS support_staff_subscribers,
       COALESCE(p.faculty_subscribers,0) AS faculty_subscribers,
       CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(l.is_active,'')) IN ('Y','YES','TRUE','T','1') THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS active_status
FROM mailing_lists l
LEFT JOIN per_list p USING (moira_list_key)
WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(l.is_moira_mailing_list,'Y')) IN ('Y','YES','TRUE','T','1')
ORDER BY support_staff_subscribers DESC NULLS LAST, faculty_subscribers DESC NULLS LAST, list_name
LIMIT 200;

# Build faculty and support sets using available columns; avoid nonexistent columns in faculty_roster.
# 1) Faculty IDs (any in roster)
_ = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE faculty_ids AS
SELECT DISTINCT CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id
FROM faculty_roster
WHERE mit_id IS NOT NULL;
""")

# 2) Employee universe from employee_directory
_ = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE employee_ids AS
SELECT DISTINCT CAST(mit_id AS BIGINT) AS mit_id,
       UPPER(COALESCE(employee_group,'')) AS employee_group,
       UPPER(COALESCE(employee_type,'')) AS employee_type,
       UPPER(COALESCE(type,'')) AS type_flag
FROM employee_directory
WHERE mit_id IS NOT NULL;
""")

# 3) Support-staff proxy: employees excluding faculty; use staff-like signals
_ = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE support_ids AS
SELECT e.mit_id
FROM employee_ids e
LEFT JOIN faculty_ids f ON f.mit_id = e.mit_id
WHERE f.mit_id IS NULL
  AND (
        type_flag = 'EMPLOYEE'
        OR employee_type IN ('STAFF','SUPPORT','SUPPORT STAFF','OTHER ACADEMIC GROUP')
        OR employee_group IN ('EXEMPT','NONEXEMPT','ADMINISTRATIVE STAFF','SUPPORT STAFF')
      );
""")

# 4) Clean list members; round float IDs to nearest int to match BIGINT
_ = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE list_members_clean AS
SELECT m.moira_list_key,
       CAST(ROUND(m.moira_list_member_mit_id) AS BIGINT) AS mit_id
FROM mailing_list_members m
WHERE m.moira_list_member_mit_id IS NOT NULL;
""")

# 5) Compute counts and return only lists with any faculty/support subscribers
_ = db_api.execute_query(user_id, chat_id, """
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH per_member AS (
  SELECT lm.moira_list_key,
         CASE WHEN f.mit_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_faculty,
         CASE WHEN s.mit_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_support
  FROM list_members_clean lm
  LEFT JOIN faculty_ids f ON f.mit_id = lm.mit_id
  LEFT JOIN support_ids s ON s.mit_id = lm.mit_id
), per_list AS (
  SELECT moira_list_key,
         SUM(is_support) AS support_staff_subscribers,
         SUM(is_faculty) AS faculty_subscribers
  FROM per_member
  GROUP BY moira_list_key
), with_lists AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.moira_list_key, l.moira_list_name,
         CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(l.is_active,'')) IN ('Y','YES','TRUE','T','1') THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS active_status
  FROM mailing_lists l
  WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(l.is_moira_mailing_list,'Y')) IN ('Y','YES','TRUE','T','1')
)
SELECT wl.moira_list_name AS list_name,
       COALESCE(pl.support_staff_subscribers,0) AS support_staff_subscribers,
       COALESCE(pl.faculty_subscribers,0) AS faculty_subscribers,
       wl.active_status
FROM with_lists wl
LEFT JOIN per_list pl USING (moira_list_key)
WHERE COALESCE(pl.support_staff_subscribers,0) > 0
   OR COALESCE(pl.faculty_subscribers,0) > 0
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wl.moira_list_name ORDER BY COALESCE(pl.support_staff_subscribers,0) DESC, COALESCE(pl.faculty_subscribers,0) DESC, wl.moira_list_key) = 1
ORDER BY support_staff_subscribers DESC NULLS LAST,
         faculty_subscribers DESC NULLS LAST,
         list_name
LIMIT 200;
""")
